cssVariables._comment: React/CSS stack: Tailwind preset maps to these custom properties. Do not use a --scorp-* color prefix.
cssVariables.globalUtilities: --opacity-*, --z-index-*, --breakpoint-*, --duration-*, --easing-*, --font-*, --line-height-*, --font-weight-*, --button-size-*, --plate-round, --plate-round-lg, --focus-ring-width, --focus-ring-offset (radius tokens retired; plates are the shape language)

_notes.tokenSource: packages/tokens/src/tokens.json is the single source of truth; tokens.css is the runtime contract for apps.
_notes.componentNaming: React components are not prefixed (Button, not ScorpButton): the @scorp-ds/components import provides the namespace.
_notes.projectPrefix: project.prefix is used only for generated doc filenames (docs/component-references/). It is NOT a component or CSS-variable prefix: components are unprefixed and custom properties never use --scorp-*.
_notes.unrealisedPaths: paths.lab, paths.samples and paths.shared are reserved layer locations that do not exist yet. Do not assume they contain anything; create the directory as part of the change that first needs it. Tooling must report a missing layer out loud rather than skipping it silently.
